function.name: EXISTS
function.param: Identifier of a process, or of a type of process obtained by the instruction .
function.abstract: Check if a determinated process is working

description.p: This function returns 1 (true) if the process identified by the parameter is still running (if it has not been eliminated of memory, nor marked for killing by a function like . It is possible to use like parameter a type of process obtained by the instruction , in which case it will return 1 if there is on memory at least a process of the indicated type. If there is not any process, EXISTS will be return 0.
